name: Roller Boys the Game
source:
Roller Boys the Game is a visual novel game where you interact with Rubens, Robson and Renato, three twenty something year old men, with a passion for roller skating. They form a group between them called Roller Boys and dream of becoming famous by roller skating. One day, an opportunity knocks at their door and they have the chance to perform at a roller skating competition, the winners will appear at a big commercial, and hopefully become famous.

[From [url=https://criatura-armadamireia.itch.io/roller-boys-the-game-def]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《轮滑男孩》（Roller Boys the Game）是一部视觉小说游戏，你将与鲁本斯、罗布森和雷纳托三位酷爱轮滑运动的二十多岁青年展开互动。三人组建了一支名为“轮滑男孩”的组合，梦想靠轮滑一举成名。某天机遇终于敲响了他们的大门——他们获得了参加一场大型轮滑比赛的机会，夺冠者不仅能出演重磅商业广告，更有望自此红遍天下。

[摘自[url=https://criatura-armadamireia.itch.io/roller-boys-the-game-def]itch.io[/url]]
